notes.account: The page identifies the gluing operation with p_*J^* of the restricted sheaf, writes the gluing datum in adjoint form, recalls the fibration/inclusion geometry, and offers two alternate span diagrams. It states that restriction is an equivalence for the sheaves in view and that the spaces in the first new diagram are homotopic to those of the previous construction. It then proposes replacing X_0 by T, saying X_0 is a deformation retract.
notes.author_explicit_uncertainty: No explicit avowal of doubt occurs. The conditional preference wording is “Si on préfère”; the comparisons “un peu moins joli” and “un peu plus canonique” are the author’s qualifications, not reader doubt.
notes.page_date_title: Author number 31 at top centre; archive pencil 176 at lower left. No date, title, heading, closing or signature on this page. Continuation begins with haut.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: The F after u was checked because an extra bar would change the sheaf datum; the ink has only the two limbs of F. Stars, mapsto bar, arrowheads, hooks, primes and label sides were checked visually. Mathematical convenience was not used to resolve the clipped T/I target or the alphabet J/j.
notes.H_editorial_claim_review: H’s final note says the bottom diagram straddles two author pages and the rest is on the next page. The whole current scan already shows its top row, horizontal label and arrow, descending hook, p-double-prime, and clipped bottom target. I reproduce only what is visible here; I have not consulted another page. H’s note is editorial and is not manuscript text or an extra transcription block.
notes.paragraphs_and_marks: The first main passage is continuous through the two displays. A clear indentation and gap introduce Si on préfère. No author underlining was identified. The apparently heavy beginning of pratiquement is ordinary compressed/retraced letter work, not a separate cancellation. Small line-end hyphens in inclusion and déformation are joined. One isolated dark bent mark beside the first diagram is reproduced with uncertain origin; no meaning is assigned.

check_events.method: Put G=J^*(F̃_1). For p^* left adjoint to p_*, the map u:F_0→p_*G corresponds to ε_G∘p^*(u):p^*F_0→G. Conversely v:p^*F_0→G gives p_*(v)∘η_F0. The two triangle identities make these constructions inverse. This checks the passage from u to the displayed ũ and the placements of the stars; it does not prove the claimed equivalence of restriction categories or geometric fibration assertions.
